label: Order
caption: HORSERACING INTEGRITY AND SAFETY AUTH., INC., ET AL. V. NAT. HORSEMEN’S BENEVOLENT AND PROTECTIVE ASSN., ET AL.
text: UPON CONSIDERATION of the application of counsel for the applicants, IT IS ORDERED that the mandate of the United States Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit, case No. 23-10520, is hereby administratively stayed pending further order of the undersigned or of the Court. It is further ordered that a response to the application be filed on or before Monday, September 30, 2024, by 4 p.m. (EDT).
